about_the_game:
Deep and rewarding but still easy for new players to pick up, this fun and wacky CCG features a tactical combat board! Placing and positioning units in strategic locations adds complexity to your game-plan. Take defensive positions to protect your castle, engage in a reckless all-out assault, or complete unique map objectives to get a leg up on your opponent. Build unique decks from 7 different iconic factions: Vikings, Crusaders, Warlocks, Pirates, Ninjas, Druids, and Undead. Combine up to two factions at once for unique gameplay strategies!

Cards and Castles ULTIMATE is the third game in the Cards and Castles series, and offers many new gameplay options.

NEW FEATURES

  • UNLIMITED DRAFTING! Create player-controlled drafting tables and participate in these small events as much as you like!

  • Dual-color cards! Ultra-powerful cards have been added that can only be played with certain faction combos.

  • GRAVEYARD system! Slain or discarded units appear as ghosts in tombs behind your Castle. Resurrect the dead, and interact with dead units in unique and interesting ways with each faction!

  • GUARDIAN position and SAFE ZONE! You can protect your Castle with any unit you choose, and protect key units from attack by placing them behind your Castle.

  • MAP OBJECTIVES. Each multiplayer map has unique secondary objectives for you to claim.

  • Faster, DEADLIER games. Less time is spent on initial setup phases, so powerful combos become possible quickly.

  • Step on enemies with the new STOMP keyword

  • No more deck restrictions on legendary cards!

  • Turbo collection speed; be free of the F2P grind, get card packs and powerful cards quickly as you play.

  • Over 500 cards to collect with more on the way!

  • New ranked system with in-game leaderboards, and ELO scoring for top players.
